content.title: How to use Signal App - Beginner Tutorial
content.text: In this step-by-step tutorial, learn how to use Signal, learn how to use the Signal messaging app to send secure and private messages to your friends and family. Signal is an end-to-end encrypted messaging app that offers a high level of privacy and security, making it an ideal choice for those who value their online privacy. First, we look at how to download and install the Signal app on your phone, and then walk you through the app's interface and features. You will learn how to add contacts, send messages, make video calls, host group chats, and even post stories with ephemeral content. By the end of this tutorial, you will be able to use Signal with confidence, knowing that your messages are secure and private.
